title: Constraint: Dynamic Array Repetition Rules
constraints: `arr.size() == len` with `len` in 5 … 12, and element values in 0 … 9.
No value appears more than **twice**, and no two **adjacent** elements are equal.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Constrain the size of a dynamic array directly: `arr.size() == len;`.
"At most twice": no three positions i < j < k may hold the same value. (Verilator does not support every reduction form on dynamic arrays; pairwise and triple loops always work.)
